attchmntText: Western Carriers (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited has released the audio recording of its earnings conference call held on November 16, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST. The discussion covered the operational and financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The audio link is available on the company website at www.western-carriers.com. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was issued by Sapna Kochar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 16, 2026.

attchmntText: Western Carriers (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited filed a notice regarding newspaper advertisements published on November 15, 2026. The disclosures were made under Regulation 30 and Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The advertisements appeared in the Financial Express All India Edition and the Dainik Statesman Kolkata edition. The information is also hosted on the company website at www.western-carriers.com. The filing was signed by Sapna Kochar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, in Kolkata, West Bengal.

attchmntText: Western Carriers (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, consolidated revenue from operations was INR 9,135 Mn with an EBITDA of INR 178 Mn and PAT of INR 91 Mn. Diluted EPS stood at INR 0.89. For the first half of fiscal year 2027, consolidated revenue from operations was INR 9,135 Mn with an EBITDA of INR 406 Mn and PAT of INR 91 Mn. Diluted EPS was INR 1.74. Total container volumes increased by 6.3% year on year in the second quarter to 59,343 TEUs. Half year volumes grew 10.3% to 1,17,604 TEUs. The company inaugurated a General Cargo Terminal at Kolkata Dock System under a 15-year agreement. It also achieved full commercial activation of its Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal at Devaliya. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Western Carriers (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at INR 448.62 crores, up 2.05 percent year on year. EBITDA was INR 21.93 crores, showing 16.52 percent growth with a margin of 4.89 percent. Profit after tax was INR 9.06 crores, with a margin of 2.02 percent. The company inaugurated a General Cargo Terminal at Kolkata Dock System under a 15-year agreement. Its 42-acre Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal at Devaliya, Morbi, achieved full commercial activation. The information is hosted on the company website at www.western-carriers.com.

attchmntText: Western Carriers (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited confirms there were no deviations or variations in the utilization of Initial Public Offer proceeds for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This statement aligns with the object clause of the Prospectus dated September 20, 2024. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement during its meeting. The company filed this disclosure with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The statement is available on the company website at www.western-carriers.com. Sapna Kochar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the letter from Kolkata, West Bengal, on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Western Carriers (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 4,486.19 million for the quarter and Rs. 9,134.94 million for the half-year. Net profit was Rs. 90.57 million for the quarter and Rs. 177.48 million for the half-year. Basic earnings per share was Rs. 0.89 for the quarter and Rs. 1.74 for the half-year. Total assets stood at Rs. 12,682.28 million as of September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and limited review reports were issued by D C Dharewa & Co.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding IPO proceeds utilization. Crisil Ratings Limited issued the report. The IPO raised Rs 4,928.80 million. Net proceeds were Rs 3,629.38 million. Utilization is as per the Offer Document. No deviations were observed. Rs 1,635.00 million for prepayment of borrowings was fully utilized. Rs 778.28 million remains unutilized for capital expenditure. Rs 477.28 million for general corporate purposes was fully utilized. Rs 21.39 million remains unutilized for issue expenses. Unutilized funds are invested in Fixed Deposits with HDFC Bank. The company purchased commercial vehicles and containers differing from the prospectus due to market conditions. This is consistent with stated objects.
